notes.title: Steam Summer Sale and next Update
notes.content:
Dear friends, followers, fans and haters, we want to inform you that Island Simulator 2016 is now 75% off !


We know that progress of this game are going very slow and we dont publish any updates since the game was published on Steam, but we are working very hard on this game and we want to finish this game. We spent a lots of money and lots of time on Island Simulator but we still need more time to fix bugs and improve gameplay.

We are now focused on fixing bugs and we want to add new content ! 


Thanks to everyone for playing the game and giving their feedback, we really appreciate all the help and support.


Sincerely,
Silverline Studios
Patryk Taranek

notes.title: Alpha 3 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey Survivalists,
We want to give you some information about Alpha 3. 

Alpha 3 Official Release Notes!

Tropical Island world updates

New Military base
Prison
Random loot system 1.1
New secret location



Added

Added: Traps 
Added:Faster reaction of our enemies
Added: Temperature system for our character
Added: Music in main menu
Added: New weapons



Changed

Changed: Reloading animation for mosin rifle


Fixed

Fixed: Green textures on Snowy Island
Fixed: Underwater soundFX
Fixed: Missing textures in Jungle Island



Known Issues

Known Issue: Sometimes crosshair in our weapons change his textures to white
Known Issue: Sometimes our enemies don't move properly



Stay Tuned 
Silverline Studios
